hero.h1: Cabinets and Countertops in Rockingham, NC
hero.subheadline: Pick your quartz, cabinets, backsplash and flooring at our US-1 showroom, then let our install team put it all in, for homes and businesses.

image.alt: Large kitchen with white raised-panel cabinets, white quartz island with seating and modern pendant lights, cabinets and countertops Rockingham NC

paragraphs: Cabinet & Countertop Solutions sells and installs cabinets and countertops in Rockingham, NC, from a showroom you can walk into on US-1. You see the slabs, flooring planks and shaker cabinet boxes in person before you choose. Counters, cabinets and floors can be matched side by side in a single visit.

Then the same company handles the install. One homeowner told us her quartz countertop and backsplash job with Carolyn and the install team was seamless from start to finish. Another bought cabinets and quartz here and had the kitchen and hallway bath renovated, appliances installed, backsplash set and rooms painted, all with one crew she named one by one.

services.h2: What you can get from our Rockingham showroom

items.name: Quartz countertops
items.blurb: White quartz with soft gray or gold veining is the most common choice in our recent kitchens, cut for L-shaped runs, large islands and undermount sinks in stainless or hammered copper. The kitchens in our Google photos all show quartz tops paired with new cabinets.

image.alt: L-shaped kitchen with white quartz countertops, white wall cabinets and gray base cabinets

items.name: Kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: We stock shaker style cabinets at the showroom, and our installs include white raised-panel kitchens with dark hardware and tall pantry units. Choose the boxes and finish here, and our team sets them square before the countertops go on.

image.alt: White raised-panel kitchen cabinets with copper range hood, wall ovens and marble mosaic backsplash

items.name: Backsplash and tile
items.blurb: Backsplash finishes the countertop job. Recent kitchens have marble mosaic tile behind a copper hood and elongated hexagon tile around the sink window. Tile and custom designs are part of what we offer for kitchens, baths and commercial spaces.

image.alt: White kitchen with quartz island, black refrigerator and mosaic tile backsplash under a pendant light

items.name: Bathroom vanity tops
items.blurb: Quartz is not only for kitchens. One client ordered two different countertops for her bathrooms and says they are just what she asked for. We cut tops for long double vanities, with undermount sinks and matching quartz splash.

image.alt: Long bathroom vanity with white quartz top, two undermount sinks and light wood drawers

items.name: Flooring
items.blurb: Our showroom carries plank flooring in gray and natural oak looks, so you can match the floor to your new cabinets and counters in one visit. Flooring sits alongside tile, cabinetry and custom designs in what we do.

image.alt: Granite slab, two wood-look flooring planks and wrapped white shaker cabinets in the showroom

items.name: Kitchen and bath remodels
items.blurb: For bigger jobs, the work goes past the counters. One family had their kitchen and hallway bathroom renovated, new appliances installed, the backsplash set and most of the house painted, and they kept the crew on for a carport.

image.alt: Two team members standing in a finished white kitchen with copper hood and white quartz island

items.title: See it before you buy
items.text: Our showroom at 899 US-1 has slabs, plank flooring and stocked shaker cabinets. Look at real materials instead of guessing from a small sample or a screen.

items.title: Supply and install together
items.text: Reviewers bought their cabinets and quartz from us and had the same company install them, so the order, the measurements and the install stay in one place.

items.title: A smooth process
items.text: One client described working with Carolyn and the install team as seamless from start to finish. Another says the finished countertops are just what she asked for.

items.title: Saturday hours
items.text: Besides Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM, we are open Saturday mornings from 9 AM to 1 PM, so you can shop without taking time off work.

about.text: Cabinet & Countertop Solutions LLC runs a showroom at 899 US-1 in Rockingham, under the black and gold C&C sign. We serve residential and commercial customers with countertops, cabinetry, flooring, tile and custom designs. Customers deal with real people: reviewers mention Carolyn by name, along with the install team that comes to your house. Our Google reviews are all five stars so far, from a single bathroom top to a full kitchen with a copper range hood, marble backsplash and a big quartz island.

image.alt: Black and gold C&C Cabinet & Countertop Solutions LLC sign with phone number outside the Rockingham showroom

steps.title: Give us a call
steps.text: Call (910) 474-1447 or email candcllc0125@gmail.com. Give us a call and we can schedule a time that works for you.

steps.title: Choose your materials
steps.text: Visit the showroom at 899 US-1 to compare quartz, cabinets, flooring and backsplash tile side by side with our team.

steps.title: Measure and order
steps.text: We measure your kitchen or bathroom so the cabinets and countertops are ordered and cut to fit your actual space.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: Our install team sets the cabinets, countertops, sink and backsplash. For larger remodels, the crew can also handle appliances and paint.

steps.title: Enjoy the result
steps.text: We check the finished install with you so the countertops and cabinets are exactly what you asked for before the team leaves.

service_area.h2: Cabinets and countertops in Rockingham, NC
service_area.text: Our showroom is at 899 US-1 in Rockingham, NC 28379, and Rockingham is the town we list for our work. We serve both homes and businesses. If you live outside town and want to know whether we can measure and install at your place, call (910) 474-1447 and we will tell you right away. You are also welcome to stop by the showroom during opening hours, Monday to Saturday, to talk through your project and look at materials.

items.q: Where is your showroom and when is it open?
items.a: We are at 899 US-1, Rockingham, NC 28379. The showroom is open Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM and Saturday from 9 AM to 1 PM. We are closed on Sunday. Look for the black and gold C&C sign out front.

items.q: Do you install, or only sell materials?
items.a: Both. Customers buy cabinets and quartz countertops from us and our install team puts them in, including sinks and backsplash. Reviewers describe the install as seamless and say the finished countertops are just what they asked for. Larger jobs can include appliances, backsplash and paint.

Countertops, cabinetry, flooring and tile. Our recent jobs use white quartz with gray or gold veining, and our showroom photos show a blue-gray granite slab, gray and oak-look flooring planks and white shaker cabinets. Call to ask about a specific color.

items.q: Do you work on bathrooms too?
items.a: Yes. We cut and install quartz vanity tops, including long double vanities with undermount sinks and matching splash. One customer ordered two different countertops for her home and says they came out just as she asked. Larger kitchen and bathroom renovations are possible too.

Call (910) 474-1447 or email candcllc0125@gmail.com. Give us a call and we can schedule a time to talk about your kitchen or bathroom. You are also welcome to stop by the showroom during opening hours to look at materials.

final_cta.text: Visit us on US-1 or call to schedule a time with our team.
